name: Sion
title: The Undead Juggernaut
description: A patch 12.8 tank who charges up crushing blows, stacks permanent health, and keeps fighting after death.

passive.name: Glory in Death
passive.short_description: After dying, briefly rise again with rapidly decaying health and empowered attacks. All ability keys become Death Surge, a one-use burst of movement speed.
passive.description: After 1.5s, rise at full health. Health decays increasingly fast, but you attack at 1.75 attack speed with 100% life steal and deal 10% of the target's maximum health as bonus physical damage (maximum 75 against minions and monsters). Death Surge grants 50% movement speed, decaying over 2.5s.

q.name: Decimating Smash
q.short_description: Hold to charge an axe smash in a fixed direction, then release. Charge for at least 1s to knock enemies up and stun them.
q.description: Charge for up to 2s. Deals 30/50/70/90/110 (+45/52.5/60/67.5/75% total AD) to 70/135/200/265/330 (+135/157.5/180/202.5/225% total AD) physical damage. At 1s or more, knocks enemies up and stuns them for 1.25-2.5s based on charge time. An interruption puts Q on a 2s cooldown.

w.name: Soul Furnace
w.short_description: Gain permanent health from kills and champion takedowns. Shield yourself, then recast after 3s to detonate the shield if it still holds.
w.description: Kills grant 4 permanent health, or 15 for champions, large monsters and large minions. Shield for 6s for 60/85/110/135/160 (+40% AP) (+10/11/12/13/14% max HP). An intact shield detonates on recast or expiry.

recast.name: Detonate Soul Furnace
recast.description: Deals 40/65/90/115/140 (+40% AP) plus 10/11/12/13/14% of the target's maximum health as magic damage. The max-health damage is capped at 400 against minions and monsters.

effects.amount: 15 + 25 * rank + 0.4 * ap + (min(400, (0.09 + 0.01 * rank) * t_max_hp) if not t_champion else (0.09 + 0.01 * rank) * t_max_hp)

e.name: Roar of the Slayer
e.short_description: Fire a shockwave that slows and shreds armor. A minion or small monster hit is hurled through enemies, applying the same effects.
e.description: Deals 65/100/135/170/205 (+55% AP) magic damage, slows by 40/45/50/55/60% for 2.5s, and reduces armor by 20% for 4s. Launches a minion or non-epic monster up to 1,350 units, hitting enemies in its path.

r.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
r.short_description: Charge toward your cursor with limited steering and crowd-control immunity. Recast to slam early, or crash into an enemy champion, a turret, or terrain.
r.description: Charge for up to 8s, accelerating to 950 movement speed. Impact deals 150/300/450 (+40% bonus AD) to 400/800/1200 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage and stuns nearby enemies for 0.75-1.75s, reaching full strength after 3s. Enemies farther from the impact are slowed for 3s.

recast.name: End Unstoppable Onslaught
recast.description: End the charge with an impact at your position.
